actions.name: fire aura
actions.desc: At the end of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns, each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=15VgJKVXwYBOFSqJ]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=15VgJKVXwYBOFSqJ]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes [[/damage average]] damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the Emanation start burning.

actions.name: fire form
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes [[/damage average]] damage.

actions.name: illumination
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

actions.name: water susceptibility
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage damage for every 5 feet the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it. Foundry Note Scaling is configured to roll the correct number of dice based on the distance traveled through water. 1 is default for 5 feet, 2 is for 10 feet, and so forth.

actions.name: burn
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts &Reference[burning].
